Parallel metadata shows actual parallel use, four subagents, artifact_ok true, and a failed official solution score.
Status shows protocol validation passed, submission packaging included compile.sh and executable, and official evaluation failed behavior tests.
Official evaluator summary reports completed evaluation with 92 passed, 158 failed, one skipped, and solution_passed false.
Final response claims a Python clean-room replacement, compile.sh, bundled assets, and verification over the probed CLI surface.

timeline_reviews.summary: Top-level trajectory is transport-only in the review manifest and mirrors the single completed task turn.
Parent trajectory probes the binary, spawns child probes, independently implements the Python replacement, verifies static and minimal documentation behavior, interrupts late children, and finalizes.
CLI probe child maps help, version, template, comparison, and failure paths, then is interrupted while writing an overlapping implementation after the parent already has enough findings.
Generation probe child inspects static generation and configuration behavior, exchanges some findings, writes a partial implementation, and is interrupted late.
Documentation probe child investigates generated documentation paths and warnings, starts its own implementation work, and is interrupted late without controlling final delivery.

direct_file_reviews.summary: Prompt is byte-identical to the parallel prompt and requires a clean-room executable reimplementation from allowed observations.
Serial metadata confirms no parallel execution, no subagents, artifact_ok false, and a failed official solution score.
Status shows a packaged Go implementation with executable but no compile.sh, artifact validation failed, and official evaluation returned compile_failed.
Official evaluator summary reports completed evaluation with error_code compile_failed, 252 tests not run, and solution_passed false.
Final response claims a standalone Go reimplementation and rebuild command, but the delivered artifact omitted the required compile script.

timeline_reviews.summary: Top-level serial trajectory is transport-only in the review manifest and records the single serial task turn.
Serial agent performs local probing and implementation, adds Go source and assets, fixes build issues, swaps the executable, verifies against a preserved reference, and finalizes without delegation.

parallel.requirements: The parallel agent recognized a clean-room Doxygen-like CLI and documentation generator, including static template modes, config update and diff modes, version/help/error output, and a minimal documentation path.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent delegated CLI, generation, and documentation probing to children while keeping final implementation, packaging, cleanup, verification, and delivery ownership in the parent trajectory.
parallel.implementation: The parent produced a Python implementation with src modules, asset bundles, launcher, compile.sh, and executable; children also explored and began overlapping code, but their code was not the delivered authority.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent assembled the final tree, kept compile.sh and executable in the submission package, and artifact validation accepted the package before official behavioral scoring.
parallel.verification: The parent ran syntax checks, compile.sh, byte comparisons for static modes, and a compact regression including version/help, config, emoji, layout, and a minimal documentation run.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite package validity and local checks, the official evaluator found broad behavioral incompleteness with 158 failures and one skipped test.

serial.requirements: The serial agent recognized the same clean-room task, CLI surface, template/static generation modes, config behavior, and documentation-generation obligation.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The single agent owned probing, implementation, testing, cleanup, final executable replacement, and final response without subagents or delegation.
serial.implementation: The serial solution used Go source files and embedded assets, fixed syntax and build issues, and created a rebuilt executable with behavior targeted to observed cases.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The final workspace contained Go sources, assets, go.mod, and executable, but the package omitted compile.sh, causing artifact validation to fail.
serial.verification: The serial agent ran Go builds and side-by-side diffs for help, version, template, comparison, static, and quiet documentation paths before finalizing.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluator reported compile_failed and did not run 252 tests because the delivered artifact did not meet the build contract.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel targeted the required clean-room executable behavior and implemented a subset of the Doxygen-like CLI plus minimal documentation generation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial targeted the same clean-room behavior and built a Go replacement with similar probed CLI and documentation coverage.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The recognized task surface was similar; the concrete official difference was not requirements discovery but parallel reaching behavioral scoring while serial missed the delivery/build contract.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split probing into CLI, generation, and documentation children while the parent retained final code and delivery ownership.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used no children and handled probing, coding, verification, and final delivery in one continuous trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used delegation for observation capacity, but there was still a clear parent implementation owner; serial was simpler but not more complete at delivery.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children exchanged findings and the parent used observed behavior to implement; no incompatible child-parent interface contract became a failed integration boundary.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no cross-agent interfaces, so all context stayed within one actor's own probe and implementation loop.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had coordination boundaries but no directly evidenced missing brief, lossy handoff, or conflicting handoff that explains the failed score.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel delivered a Python replacement with a launcher, assets, compile script, and final executable, after fixing a Python syntax issue and narrowing behavior.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial delivered a Go replacement, recovered from Go build failures, and embedded observed assets into the executable workflow.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The implementation languages and packaging differed; parallel produced a package-valid tree but behavior-incomplete code, while serial produced runnable Go code locally but omitted compile.sh from the official artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel waited for children at several points and later interrupted still-running children after parent implementation and verification were already in place.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results to join or retrieve and closed after its own local verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The only visible lifecycle tension is late child interruption; it did not leave a needed completed child result unjoined or displace the parent-owned final artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel final artifact included src, compile.sh, assets, and executable, and artifact validation marked it ok.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial final artifact included Go source and executable but omitted compile.sh, and artifact validation marked it not ok.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel satisfied the packaging contract and reached behavioral tests; serial's packaging omission caused compile_failed before behavior was evaluated.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran a compact regression that printed ALL_OK for the probed surface before finalizing, then official tests exposed many remaining behavioral misses.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran side-by-side checks and accepted path-only differences, then official evaluation failed at compile/package validation before running tests.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both relied on local sample-based verification; parallel's checks were insufficient for hidden behavior, while serial's checks missed the required build artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel consumed more budget with children and interrupted them late, but still closed with a built package and local verification before the official run.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial consumed a single-agent budget, completed a final executable swap, and closed with a final response but without compile.sh.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closure was behavior-incomplete after successful packaging; serial closure was delivery-incomplete despite local executable checks.

outcome_analysis.explanation: Both official outcomes are failures. Parallel packaged a valid Python submission with compile.sh and executable, so the evaluator ran behavioral tests and reported 92 passed, 158 failed, and one skipped. Serial produced and locally verified a Go executable, but its artifact lacked compile.sh and was rejected as compile_failed, so 252 tests were not run. The concrete task-solving difference is delivery/build-contract compliance versus behavioral breadth, not a discordant pass/fail result and not an evidenced parallel coordination failure.
parallel_contributors: Package-valid final tree with compile.sh allowed behavioral evaluation.
Narrow local verification covered common CLI and minimal documentation paths but missed broad hidden behavior.
serial_contributors: Single-agent implementation produced an executable and source files.
Final artifact omitted compile.sh, producing official compile_failed before behavioral tests ran.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel was behavior-incomplete despite packaging correctly.
Serial was delivery-incomplete despite a locally built Go executable.
evaluator_effects: Serial compile_failed means the official score did not measure its behavioral implementation coverage.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no pass/fail outcome difference; supported explanation of different failure modes

There were no independently delivered components that lacked an integration owner; the parent owned final integration and packaging.
Final assembly was not ownerless because the parent created compile.sh, built executable, cleaned the tree, and produced the final artifact.
The parent drove the end-to-end transition from probing to implementation, local checks, cleanup, and final response.
The parent began probing and implementation work while children ran; no mandatory serial preflight blocked productive work.
Although much early work was investigation, implementation began with enough time and was completed to a package-valid artifact rather than being deferred past closure.
The indispensable implementation, build, and package path stayed with the parent and completed; child activity did not starve that path.
The run used several children and many waits, but did not close from exhausted fan-out before implementing, building, verifying, and packaging.
No single child owned an indispensable overbroad deliverable whose incompletion blocked the final artifact; parent-owned implementation reached closure.
The retained delivery was parent-owned; no child followed an incomplete brief that made its work unusable or caused a missing required stage.
Children were primarily probes, not separately owned interoperating modules; no missing cross-agent contract produced incompatible integrated work.
No known finding is shown disappearing across a transfer and causing repeated work or an incorrect parent action.
Returned or exchanged findings were not shown to be too large for the parent to reduce before decision; the parent continued implementing and verifying.
No parent action is shown consuming a superseded child report or stale workspace state that caused rework or invalid verification.
No incompatible child reports or contracts remained unadjudicated at the parent decision point.
The parent did run integrated local checks before finalizing; the later evaluator failure alone is hidden behavioral incompleteness, not unsupported global acceptance.
There was no replacement or retry child repeating earlier work without inherited findings or current workspace state.

No verifier child produced a concrete finding trapped below the parent before closure.
Cancelled children did not own a required unfinished scope that the parent abandoned; the parent had already taken the necessary final work over.
No completed child result is visible at a decision point and then ignored in a way that made the final action inconsistent with it.
The parent did wait on children, but also continued probing, implementing, checking, and later inspecting agent state; waiting alone did not cause closure failure.
Children began overlapping implementation work, but there is no realized incompatible design that the parent integrated or had to reconcile into the delivered artifact.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: Late child interruption, wait timeouts, and unfinished child implementation were reviewed as one lifecycle chain and not split into load, timing, monitoring, or takeover labels because the parent-owned final artifact was already built and verified.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and all 32 Level-3 candidates were audited; no parallel coordination boundary had a realized adverse consequence beyond ordinary implementation incompleteness.
